candidate_eligibility.training_rule: all eligible matches strictly before the validation year
candidate_eligibility.same_day_rule: predict every match on a date before updating histories with any result from that date
candidate_eligibility.exposed_2025_2026_period: retrospective diagnostics only; never pristine or independently confirmatory

bootstrap.rationale: Date blocks preserve same-day dependence and paired candidate/comparator observations; deterministic sampling makes reruns auditable.

brier_difference.rationale: Brier is the primary multiclass proper score; one percentage point is meaningful harm on its observed scale.

log_loss_difference.rationale: Log loss must improve and a two-hundredths increase is treated as material harm.

poisson_deviance_difference.rationale: The changed goal model must improve likelihood-based goal fit; three-hundredths is the harm margin.

goal_difference_mae_difference_max.rationale: A small tolerance permits noise while prohibiting a meaningful loss of goal-margin quality.

simple_baseline_brier_regression_max.rationale: Candidate must beat equal one-third probabilities on the identical matches.

minimum_improving_folds.rationale: Requires temporal stability across a majority of three folds.

maximum_materially_regressing_folds.rationale: A candidate may not repeatedly cause material harm.

single_fold_improvement_share_max.rationale: Flags concentration when one fold supplies nearly all positive aggregate gain.

class_brier_regression_max.rationale: Protects home, draw, and away outcomes from masked aggregate harm.

total_goal_bias_absolute_max.rationale: Average total-goal bias above 0.15 goals per match is operationally severe.

side_goal_bias_absolute_max.rationale: Average home or away bias above 0.10 goals is operationally severe.

support_aware_mce_regression_max.rationale: Only adequately supported fixed-width cells gate calibration; sparse raw MCE remains reported.

above_80_rate_increase_max.rationale: Prevents unsupported creation of extreme forecasts.

high_confidence_gap_regression_max.rationale: High-confidence calibration gates only operate with useful support.

mid_high_confidence_gap_max.rationale: 60-80 percent buckets must be reasonably calibrated when sufficiently populated.

deterministic_metric_tolerance.rationale: Identical code, plan, data, and parameters should reproduce floating metrics to numerical precision.

expected_goal_bounds.rationale: Matches the documented model domain and prevents pathological Poisson means.

decision_rule: Every required condition must pass. Thresholds and candidate parameters may not change after the experiment plan is locked.
